# Terradrift

> > Terradrift is an outdoor gear review and adventure guide platform focused on ultralight backpacking, sustainable outdoor equipment, and eco-conscious adventure travel.

The site features in-depth reviews of ultralight and sustainable outdoor gear from brands like Gossamer Gear, Big Agnes, Osprey, and PrimaLoft, alongside practical backpacking guides and destination-focused adventure content. Terradrift emphasizes environmentally responsible gear choices, including recycled materials, biodegradable insulation, and circular economy solutions.

## Key Topics

- Ultralight backpacking
- Sustainable outdoor gear
- Gossamer Gear
- PrimaLoft Bio biodegradable insulation
- Recycled materials
- Gear reviews and testing
- Big Agnes Tiger Wall
- Osprey Atmos
- Backpacking essentials
- Eco-conscious adventure travel
- Microplastic solutions
- Circular economy
- Camping equipment
- Trail-tested gear recommendations
